name: training_window_range

changes.training: An omitted last window resolves to the actual complete calendar range before validation and registration. Explicit first/last ranges retain their behavior; no complete window remains an error.
changes.cli: Represent omitted --last as None, document its full-range behavior, and preserve early rejection of invalid explicit bounds.
changes.fit_comparison: Derive expected model and forecast paths from each run's registered fold range and latest-fit flag. Bind protocol/status identity and completion. Require both actual inventories to match the registered inventory and each other; reject missing and extra artifacts instead of assuming 48 models and 12 forecasts.
changes.registered_exit_study: Derive model count from its registered run inventory and comparison account count from its frozen baseline summary; retain fixed source/data guards and candidate budget.
changes.verification: Replace the historical 75-account docstring with all active-policy accounts; executable statements remain exact.

invariants: All 34959 existing frozen files retain exact bytes and hashes.
Active configuration, data, calendar, forecasts, evaluation and frozen paper plan remain unchanged.
Every numerical fitting, prediction, calibration, selection, execution, risk and ledger function remains byte-identical or AST-identical as explicitly scoped below.

training.run_window and every other training function remain AST-identical. run_training changes only its optional last argument, resolving it before the unchanged bounds check, and explanatory documentation.
feasibility.account_differences is unchanged; fit_parity comparison arithmetic and equality thresholds remain unchanged.
No model identity/source guard is bypassed or rewritten. Old training records retain the source identities that actually executed them.
Balanced attack, 8% warning, original high-water mark, latched risk, positive_score adoption and legacy turnover remain unchanged.
No new alpha candidates, thresholds, data facts, future prices, future training or forward observations.

validation.range_cases: Synthetic calendars with zero, one, eleven and twelve complete windows; default/full, explicit partial, first-only, latest-fit and invalid bounds through function and CLI. Compare current eleven-window invocation trace against the original source.
validation.inventory_cases: One, eleven and twelve-window registered runs, with and without latest fit and explicit partial ranges. Reject empty, missing, extra, changed or mismatched model/forecast inventories and inconsistent protocol/status identities.
validation.real_default_trace: Invoke orchestration on the actual frozen calendar with fitting calls captured; default calls must match the original eleven-window source and its registration, apart from honest changed source identities.
validation.refitting: No refitting is claimed or required for this non-numerical maintenance. AST/module scope, real-calendar invocation parity, ordinary model reloads and full account/paper replays must independently pass. Any unexpected numerical change requires a separately registered scope before proceeding.
validation.publication: Ruff and full pytest, physical frozen-file integrity, active CLI/plan bindings, actual three-environment CI and all changed remote Git/LFS bytes.
